title: From 7 years of failure to a $4M business: a 4-step LinkedIn plan to find a niche and build an audience
summary: Justin lays out what he'd do if starting over today: pick a niche at the intersection of skill, passion and willingness to pay, post with a "Teach, Teach, Teach, Sell" mix, comment on 9 relevant posts daily, and use analytics to adjust. Built for LinkedIn but works on other platforms.

principles.text: Pick a niche where what you're good at, what you love, and what people will pay for overlap.
principles.quote: Start by identifying the intersection of something you’re good at, something you love to do, and something people are willing to pay you for.

principles.text: Add a distinctive angle to your niche, like serving a specific type of person, to stand out.
principles.quote: Your niche could be ‘Confident Public Speaking for Introverted Professionals.’

principles.text: Use a Teach, Teach, Teach, Sell content mix: 80% value, 20% soft promotion.
principles.quote: 80% of the time you’ll provide value to your audience. And 20% of the time, you’ll softly promote your expertise, products, or services.

principles.text: Consistent teaching content builds the trust, expertise and authority needed to generate leads.
principles.quote: If you follow this 5-post cycle consistently, you'll establish the trust, expertise, and authority I talk about so often.

principles.text: Comment thoughtfully on 9 relevant posts daily to build visibility and relationships, for a year.
principles.quote: My 18 cent strategy just means leaving your two cents on 9 relevant posts per day.

principles.text: Track what works, adjust content to data and feedback, and ask people when you don't know what they want.
principles.quote: And if you don’t know what people want, ask them.
